cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import extreme_controller
from protocol import loads, validate
cases = [extreme_controller.build('route', rounds=20), extreme_controller.build('admit', rounds=20)]
t = json.dumps({'cases': cases}, separators=(',',':'))
req = validate(loads(t)); print('ok bytes', len(t), 'events', sum(len(c['events']) for c in req['cases']))
open('/tmp/extreme.json','w').write(t)
" && /tmp/timeit.sh /tmp/extreme.json /tmp/extremeout.json && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.deps python3 -c "
import sys, math; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import verify
text=open('/tmp/extreme.json').read(); out=open('/tmp/extremeout.json').read()
worst = {'h*delta':0.0,'1-sum t':0.0,'maxh':0.0,'maxload':0.0,'press':0.0,'dual':0.0}
orig = verify.Checker.do_step
def do_step(self, ev, got):
    if got['status'] == 'advanced':
        live = self.live()
        X = self.utilization()
        V = [self.alpha*X[e] + (1-self.alpha)*self.z[e] + self.u[e] for e in live]
        s = math.fsum(got['pressure'][e] for e in live)
        worst['1-sum t'] = max(worst['1-sum t'], -(1.0-s))
        worst['h*delta'] = max(worst['h*delta'], abs(got['ceiling']*(1.0-s)))
        worst['maxh'] = max(worst['maxh'], got['ceiling'])
        worst['maxload'] = max(worst['maxload'], max(got['load']))
        for i,e in enumerate(live):
            worst['press'] = max(worst['press'], abs(self.rho*(got['z'][e]-V[i])+got['pressure'][e])/(1e-7*(1+abs(got['pressure'][e]))))
            worst['dual'] = max(worst['dual'], abs(got['dual'][e]-(V[i]-got['z'][e]))/(1e-7*(1+abs(got['dual'][e]))))
    return orig(self, ev, got)
verify.Checker.do_step = do_step
try:
    verify.check(text, out); print('verify ok')
except verify.Bad as e: print('FAIL', e)
print(worst)
"
